name: Mount St. Joseph University
academic_ranking: Private Catholic liberal arts and sciences university organized into four schools (Arts & Sciences, Business & Communication, Education, Health Sciences). Offers a broad range of undergraduate majors, minors, certificates, pre-professional and graduate programs, plus an Honors Program and select three-year degree tracks. Reported 10:1 student-to-faculty ratio.
financial_aid: Full-time traditional undergraduates in 2025 were awarded over $31 million in scholarships/grants, with an average aid package of $38,851.20. Merit scholarships range $1,000-$26,000; need-based grants (MSJ Grant, Pell, Ohio College Opportunity Grant, Catholic HS GAP Awards up to 85% off tuition/room/board) range $500-$13,000. Federal/parent loans, work study, and an interest-free Nelnet payment plan are available. Apply via FAFSA (code 003033).
facilities_notes: Softball plays at the Mount St. Joseph Softball Complex (listed among MSJ athletic facilities). No detailed venue description published on the facilities page as of 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference. As a D3 program, no athletic scholarships are offered; recruits are supported through academic and need-based aid.
